upstream_tag_sha__command: json=$(cat meta.json) && upstream_image=$(jq -re '.upstream_image' <<< "${json}") && upstream_image_base=$(basename "${upstream_image}") && upstream_tag=$(jq -re '.upstream_tag' <<< "${json}") && tags_json=$(curl -fsSL ${GITHUB_TOKEN:+--header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"} "https://hotio.dev/containers/${upstream_image_base}-tags.json") && commit_sha=$(jq -r --arg tag "${upstream_tag}" '.[$tag].commit_sha' <<< "${tags_json}") && upstream_tag_sha=${upstream_tag}-${commit_sha:0:7} && echo "${upstream_tag_sha}"
version__command: if ! test -f cache-page1.json; then curl -fsSL ${GITHUB_TOKEN:+--header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"} "https://api.github.com/repos/slskd/slskd/actions/runs?branch=master&exclude_pull_requests=true" > cache-page1.json; fi && url=$(cat cache-page1.json | jq -re '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.name == "CI") | select(.conclusion == "success") | .artifacts_url][0]') && if ! test -f cache-page2.json; then curl -fsSL ${GITHUB_TOKEN:+--header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"} "${url}?per_page=100" > cache-page2.json; fi && cat cache-page2.json | jq -re '.artifacts[] | select(.name | contains("linux-musl-x64")) | .name' | sed -e 's/slskd-//' -e 's/-.*//'
